# Net Worth Ledger

**A live personal-finance tracker with web-refreshable balances.**

A net-worth ledger that aggregates assets and liabilities into a single live number, with on-demand refresh. It's the same 'clean numbers from messy inputs' discipline I used managing commissions and financial reporting earlier in my career — now automated.

## Highlights
- Aggregated live net-worth total
- Manual + web-search-driven balance refresh
- Auditable history

## Stack
Node.js, SQLite, Web search refresh
